description: This source file contains unit tests for Orleans configuration utilities, focusing on redacting sensitive information such as connection strings in logs and diagnostics. It verifies that account keys and passwords are replaced with placeholders to prevent exposure of secrets.

classes.name: ConfigTests
classes.description: Unit tests for verifying proper redaction of sensitive data in Orleans configuration connection strings.

methods.name: Config_AzureConnectionInfo
methods.description: Tests that Azure Storage connection strings have account keys properly redacted to prevent exposure of sensitive information.

methods.name: Config_AdoNetConnectionInfo
methods.description: Tests that SQL Server connection strings have passwords redacted to avoid exposing database credentials.
